commonRationale: Margins are smallest effects worth interpreting, fixed without pilot outcomes. Five-percentage-point behavioral margins reuse E03's already frozen practical equivalence scale. More specialized outcomes use declared scale-specific thresholds; pilots may estimate variance but cannot revise these values.

h8RegisteredSpaces.privateState: sender top-utility candidate position in the scenario's committed candidate order; deterministic lowest-position tie break
h8RegisteredSpaces.intendedAction: selected candidate position or explicit no-agreement action
h8RegisteredSpaces.pairedCaseRule: aligned and conflicting conditions must use identical committed scenario/case IDs and candidate order

members.rationale: Below five percentage points is not treated as meaningfully beyond the qualified control scale.
Requires a visible causal redistribution of at least five probability points on paired interventions.
Uses the same five-point task-success relevance scale under matched compute and capacity.
Requires a two-hundredths proper-score gain over the validation-selected strongest eligible comparator; zero-only superiority is insufficient.

members.unit: seed acquisition probability and positive time ratio
members.rationale: At least half of seeds must acquire a persistent convention and blank carriers must take at least 25 percent longer than fixed tokens.
A reduction smaller than one tenth of a turn over the fixed repair horizon is not interpreted as useful.
Preserves the already frozen practical leakage bound.
Partner-varied training must reduce replacement degradation by at least five success-probability points.
Requires both a nontrivial information loss and a ten-percentage-point increase in intended-action ambiguity on paired cases.

amendmentRule: Changing any metric, rule parameter, registered space, direction, or margin requires a prospective versioned amendment before the first family pilot; observed pilot values cannot justify a change.
claimBoundary: This is an outcome-blind design policy, not pilot evidence, a power result, a selected seed count, a scientific finding, resource authorization, or independent review.
